scope: D2 receipt time, independent cache age, expiry and shared request lifecycle; D3/D8 fixes deferred

source_inspection.receipt: Sample actual RTC UTC when accepting weather. The wire has no source observation timestamp; UI says received
source_inspection.age: Monotonic milliseconds extended from uint32 RT-Thread ticks under weather_lock before scaling. Tick rate is 1000 Hz; worker samples at least every three hours
source_inspection.independent_age: Current, forecast and solar receipts age independently; same-source inherited extras do not renew
source_inspection.request: Service owns ID, connection generation, fixed deadline and status. Reentry coalesces without renewal; failed queue/TX, disconnect and timeout finish pending; only valid weather completes successfully
source_inspection.callback_context: BLE callbacks update link fields and queue only; peer reader detects generation changes without adding weather locks in callbacks
source_inspection.time_unknown: No clock adapter means unknown age. Unset RTC remains UTC=0 while monotonic age is valid
source_inspection.ui: Read-only snapshot; retain stale current values with explicit hint and retry; expired extras become unavailable; unchanged snapshots skip redraw
source_inspection.automatic_followup: At most one automatic v2 attempt per connection; explicit retry remains possible
source_inspection.d3: Existing origin/main condition: missing app/unsupported size can reset full layout, and fallback target lookup lacks null check. Full current default registry/layout match; no current device NVS inspection
source_inspection.d8: Multiple producers assign sequence before copying and queue insertion; non-atomic increment/reversed insertion can cause false gap. Source-feasible, not hardware reproduced

host.snapshot_kind: Synthetic data rendered by actual LVGL; not hardware evidence
host.xml_export: Not repeated; XML, generated sources and fonts unchanged

review_fixes: Extend raw ticks before millisecond conversion; bound idle worker wait below raw tick wrap
Keep deadline transition in poll so remaining-time read cannot swallow timeout event
Detect link generation in service without weather mutex calls from BLE callbacks
Preserve stale failure/timeout hints and usable retry; verify glyphs and button geometry
